content: ⌊ DRAFT g When explicit unqueued communication via dataReceivePointByArgument s applies, and the Resource Entry created ac- cording to[SWS_SwCluC_03126] is not connected, the Rte_Rips_Read shall copy the value of default data instance created according to [SWS_SwCluC_03120] to the location of the OUT parameter <data>, and shall return RTE_E_UNCONNECTED .
